title: store.owner.changed
description: Triggered when store ownership moves to another user. Generated from https://docs.salla.dev/webhook-events/store (fetched 2026-10-26).

event.description: Event title or label to represent the event.

merchant.description: Merchant ID who installed the application on their store. Get details on the Merchant via the ID  using the endpoint [here](https://docs.salla.dev/api-8330089)

created_at.description: The date and time when a particular event was created or initiated.

id.description: A unique identifier of the user.

status.description: Indicates the current status of the user.

enabled.description: Indicates whether the user account is enabled or not.

mobile.description: Store owner mobile number without the country code.

mobile_code.description: The country code for the mobile phone number.

avatar.description: A URL of the store owner user avatar image.
